Track 4 follow-up to `robofab-selfparts`: the arm that builds generation k+1 is the printed gripper of generation k.

- Exhaustive assembly search: required jaw opening is exactly 30·s mm at scale s.
- With an assumed opening of 32·s − 2·t (fixed-size pads), a copy is buildable only for s ≥ t; a stroke cap S needs 30·t ≤ S.
- Chains from seeds of 130/140 mm sustain; 60/100 mm seeds decay.
- Largely algebraic given the assumption; stylised, one toy design, simulation only.

`python site/build.py` prints ok; 6 tests pass.
